nodes.label: Implied Input from Conversion Standards (Line-Sum Hint)
nodes.norm_label: implied input from conversion standards (line-sum hint)
nodes.rationale: Two modes: if any line's meat has a real conversion standard for this pair, compute IMPLIED INPUT (qty/ratio); lines with no standard are excluded and counted separately, not zero. If no line has a standard, falls back to a naive raw sum with different units, explicitly caveated. Informational only, never blocking - same philosophy as every other Actual-vs-Calculated comparison in the app.

nodes.label: currentOnHand (Prefer Actual over Calculated)
nodes.rationale: Real physical count wins over calculated ending when both exist; null means MISSING_BEGINNING_STOCK (no beginning stock ever established), not zero. Mirrors server/routes/dashboard.js's currentBalance convention.

nodes.label: Dashboard Reverse-Conversion Rollup
nodes.rationale: Restaurant columns reverse-convert a restaurant's own portioned stock back to a Commissary-meat-equivalent using Conversion Standards from Settings; a meat with no standard for a restaurant isn't counted under that column ('n/a'), same as it isn't tracked as coming from Commissary at all.
